title: 2026 Worlds Tee (Green) Avatar Item
description: Redeem this promo code for the 2026 Worlds Tee (Green) avatar item from the 2026 Pokémon World Championships. Expires Friday, September 11, 2026, at 20:00 UTC. More details here.

title: MLB-branded T-shirt Avatar Item
description: To celebrate the Pokémon GO and Major League Baseball collaboration returning for the 2026 season, trainers can redeem this code to get an exclusive MLB-branded T-shirt avatar item. Learn more here.

title: LEGO × Pokémon GO Cap Timed Research
description: Redeem this promo code for Bonus Timed Research that awards berries, XP, Stardust, and the 2026 LEGO® Pokémon Cap. The Cap Timed Research is only available in select countries, including but not exclusive to the ones with participating LEGO Stores. Trainers in countries that are not included will get Timed Research that rewards a Lucky Egg instead. Research details here.

title: LEGO × Pokémon GO Berries
description: Promo code for free berries and Poké Balls tied to the Pokémon GO and LEGO Group partnership. Learn more here.

title: FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON Hoodie Avatar Item
description: Trainers can redeem this code to get an exclusive FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON hoodie avatar item. (This code should have expired on January 4, 2025 but it appears to still work.)

title: GO Fest 2026: Global – 750K Check-Ins
description: To celebrate Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global, this code unlocked after the community reached 750K check-ins at local meetups. Check-in window was July 11 at 6 a.m. to July 12 at 8 p.m. local time. Trainers at the maximum Link Charge capacity will need to free up space before redeeming this reward code.

title: GO Fest 2026: Global – 750K RSVPs
description: To celebrate Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global, this code unlocked after the community reached 750K RSVPs to local meetups. RSVP window was July 7 at midnight to July 11 at 10 a.m. local time. Trainers at the maximum Link Charge capacity will need to free up space before redeeming this reward code.

title: GO Tour: Kalos - Starter Encounter Timed Research
description: Timed Research to encounter 6 of your choice of Fennekin, Froakie, or Chespin with a Special Background for Pokémon GO Tour: Kalos - Global.
